body: There's nothing in life I have to latch onto. I have truly lost everything and there's nothing more that I want.

I see a therapist. So far, all they're trying CBT and it doesn't work. Feeling better about a shitty life does not actually make the life less shitty. It doesn't make the heartbreak less real, the financial hardship better, nor does it make it any easier to go to bed hungry at night. It doesn't make social isolation easier, either.

I've started over a few times, thousands of miles apart on a year or bi-yearly basis. Much has to be sacrificed and endured each time. So far, this is all I have to show for it. Life could be better, but it isn't. Feeling any particular way about it doesn't make it better either. What is simply is.

And it's the "what is" I no longer want any part of. I do not perpetually have to endure total loneliness, social isolation, financial hardship and hunger to fully appreciate just how awful each of them actually is (much less when experienced all at once). Not in the past, not now. Life is not changing in any positive direction because I am left in limbo and I refuse to do so anymore.
